newsitem.title: USA: Iomega to list stock on the NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Iomega to list stock on the NYSE.

text.p: Iomega Corp, which becomes the latest high-profile technology to leave the NASDAQ, said it will file an application to list its common stock, preferred stock and its convertible notes on the New York Stock Exchange.

"We feel that listing on the New York Stock Exchange is in the long term best interests of our shareholders," said Kim Edwards, president and CEO, in a statement. "This is a natural step as the story of the new Iomega continues to unfold."
Iomega, founded in 1980 and publicly traded since 1983, has 127 million shares outstanding. Iomega said it expects its symbol to begin trading as IOM in the near future.
